## 🎯 Strategic Alignment with Active Goals

### 1. The Path to Level 120 Necromancy
Reaching Level 120 Necromancy requires **104,273,167 Total XP**. At Level 106, you have established a massive foundation with over 28M XP.

* **Necroplasm Management**: You actively plan to convert lower-tier necroplasms into [Powerful Necroplasm](https://runescape.wiki/w/Powerful_necroplasm). Utilizing the [City of Um](https://runescape.wiki/w/City_of_Um) Ritual Site with maximum Alteration glyphs (such as [Multiply Glyphs](https://runescape.wiki/w/Multiply_I)) will drastically boost your yields when producing high-tier reagents required for [Greater Communal Rituals](https://runescape.wiki/w/Rituals).
* **XP Acceleration**: Continue balancing ritual output for optimal spirit attraction and souls while running high-level combat training at monsters like [Hermod, Spirit of War](https://runescape.wiki/w/Hermod,_Spirit_of_War) or high-density combat zones.

### 2. Necromancy Quest Completion
You have recently completed [Tomes of the Warlock](https://runescape.wiki/w/Tomes_of_the_Warlock), [Rune Mythos](https://runescape.wiki/w/Rune_Mythos), and [Vessel of the Harbinger](https://runescape.wiki/w/Vessel_of_the_Harbinger).
* **Remaining Objectives**: Ensure all remaining seasonal and story-line Necromancy requirements (such as [Alpha and Omega](https://runescape.wiki/w/Alpha_and_Omega)) are cleared to unlock full talent tree potential and tier 90/95 power gear upgrades.

## 🦅 Bossing Strategy: Kree'arra Optimization

[Kree'arra](https://runescape.wiki/w/Kree%27arra) in the [God Wars Dungeon](https://runescape.wiki/w/God_Wars_Dungeon) remains one of your absolute favorite boss targets.

* **Necromancy Combat Method**: Necromancy easily bypasses traditional combat triangle restrictions at Armadyl's Eyrie. With your [Full Slayer Helmet](https://runescape.wiki/w/Full_slayer_helmet), running Aviansie or boss Slayer tasks provides a **14.5% damage and accuracy boost** in combat.
* **Summoning & Conjures**: Deploy your [Skeleton Warrior](https://runescape.wiki/w/Conjure_Skeleton_Warrior), [Zombie](https://runescape.wiki/w/Conjure_Putrid_Zombie), and [Ghost](https://runescape.wiki/w/Conjure_Vengeful_Ghost) before entering the chamber. The Ghost's haunt command provides reliable passive healing, allowing for extended afk/low-intensity trips.
* **Overload & Prayer Thresholds**: Work toward unlocking [Overload](https://runescape.wiki/w/Overload) potion variants via [Herblore](https://runescape.wiki/w/Herblore_training) (currently Level 75) to further maximize kill speed and sustain capability.
